stem_book: Paragraph: Consider the system of equations sin x·cos2y = (a² − 1)² + 1, cos x·sin2y = a + 1. Question: The number of values of x ∈ [0, 2π], when the system has solution for permissible values of a, is/are (a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) 4
work: a = −1 ⇒ sin x cos2y = 1 ⇒ sin x = ±1 ⇒ x = π/2, 3π/2 ⇒ 2
